No source found agrees with the recorded Owner1='Cheniere Energy' (100%). resolutions.researcher_notes: Status=operating is corroborated by three independent sources spanning 2015-2017: FERC's 2015 in-service authorization for the expansion, Cheniere's current page describing 24/7 active monitoring, and 2017 trade-press reporting of live daily gas flows on the line (556-680 MMcf/d).
